```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
root <- normalizePath(file.path(knitr::opts_knit$get("root.dir") %||% getwd(), ".."))
if (!file.exists(file.path(root, "Analysis", "R", "config.R"))) root <- normalizePath(".")
stopifnot(file.exists(file.path(root, "Analysis", "R", "config.R")))
for (f in c("config.R", "prepare.R", "models.R")) source(file.path(root, "Analysis", "R", f))
stopifnot(params$mode %in% c("simulated", "real"))
set.seed(SEED)
out_dir <- file.path(root, "Analysis", "output", params$mode, "ratings")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
save_tab <- function(x, name) { write.csv(x, file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE, na = ""); invisible(x) }
show <- function(x, digits = 3) knitr::kable(x, digits = digits, row.names = FALSE)
```

**Data mode: `r params$mode`.** `r if (params$mode == "simulated") "These results come from SYNTHETIC data with planted effects. They test the code and say nothing about the studies." else "These results come from the real, de-identified data."`

```{r load}
all1 <- prepare_study(1, params$mode, root)
all2 <- prepare_study(2, params$mode, root)
d1 <- analysis_sample(all1)
d2 <- analysis_sample(all2)
# In real mode the samples must equal the registered sizes (Section 5); stop otherwise.
if (params$mode == "real" && (nrow(d1) != 228 || nrow(d2) != 261 || sum(d2$in_2025_interim == 0) != 164))
  stop("Analysis samples differ from the registered sizes (228, 261, 164 unseen): ",
       nrow(d1), ", ", nrow(d2), ", ", sum(d2$in_2025_interim == 0))
```

# Participant flow

Counts at each inclusion step (Section 5), per cell.

```{r flow}
flow <- rbind(inclusion_counts(all1, 1), inclusion_counts(all2, 2))
show(save_tab(flow, "participant_flow"))
# In real mode the whole flow must equal the registered table (Section 5).
if (params$mode == "real") {
  reg <- list(`1` = c(assigned = 269, finished = 264, passed = 246, first = 246, serious = 228),
              `2` = c(assigned = 502, finished = 440, passed = 403, first = 267, serious = 261))
  for (s in c("1", "2")) {
    got <- unlist(flow[flow$study == as.integer(s) & flow$cell == "TOTAL", names(reg[[s]])])
    if (!identical(as.numeric(got), as.numeric(reg[[s]])))
      stop("Study ", s, " flow differs from the registered table: ", paste(names(got), got, collapse = ", "))
  }
}
```

Whether exclusion rates differ by condition (Section 6, Attrition).

```{r attrition}
show(save_tab(rbind(attrition_tests(all1, 1), attrition_tests(all2, 2)), "attrition_tests"))
```

`r if (params$mode == "real") { if (sum(all1$included) != 228 || sum(all2$included) != 261 || sum(d2$in_2025_interim == 0) != 164) "**STOP: the analysis samples do not match the registered sizes (228, 261, 164 unseen).**" else "The analysis samples match the registered sizes: 228 (Study 1), 261 (Study 2), 164 of them unseen." } else ""`

# Composites

Cronbach's alpha, descriptive only (Section 5).

```{r alpha}
show(save_tab(rbind(composite_alpha(d1, 1), composite_alpha(d2, 2)), "composite_alpha"))
```

# Confirmatory tests (Study 2)

C1-C5, Holm-adjusted together. C4 enters the family with its equivalence (TOST) p value; its two-sided test of a difference is reported alongside. A test is supported if its Holm-adjusted p < .05, its sign matches the prediction where one is made, its estimate has the same sign in the unseen responses, and (C5 only) the ordinal model agrees in sign and has p < .05.

```{r confirmatory}
conf <- run_confirmatory(d2)
save_tab(conf, "confirmatory_C1_C5")
save_tab(attr(conf, "unseen_table"), "confirmatory_C1_C5_unseen_subset")
show(conf[, c("test", "outcome", "label", "n", "estimate", "ci_low", "ci_high", "d", "p_two_sided",
              "p_family", "p_holm", "sign_matches_prediction", "n_unseen", "estimate_unseen",
              "same_sign_unseen", "ordinal_agrees", "verdict")])
```

Equivalence detail for C4 (bound ±`r EQUIV_BOUND` points on the 1-5 scale):

```{r c4}
show(conf[conf$test == "C4", c("estimate", "ci90_low", "ci90_high", "ci90_within_bounds", "holm_alpha_c4",
                               "ci_holm_low", "ci_holm_high", "tost_p", "p_holm", "p_two_sided")])
```

# Results tables (secondary)

Every term for every rating outcome. `p_holm_primary_family`: Holm across all terms and the four primary outcomes (registered). `p_holm_secondary_family`: the same adjustment across all terms and the secondary outcomes (added for completeness; not named in the plan). Interactions are claimed only if the linear and ordinal models agree in sign and both have p < .05.

## Study 2

```{r study2}
tab2 <- all_terms(d2, 2)
save_tab(tab2, "study2_all_terms")
show(tab2[, c("outcome", "label", "estimate", "ci_low", "ci_high", "d", "eta2_partial", "p",
              "p_holm_primary_family", "p_holm_secondary_family", "ord_p", "interaction_claim")])
```

## Study 1

```{r study1}
tab1 <- all_terms(d1, 1)
save_tab(tab1, "study1_all_terms")
show(tab1[, c("outcome", "label", "estimate", "ci_low", "ci_high", "d", "eta2_partial", "p",
              "p_holm_primary_family", "p_holm_secondary_family", "ord_p", "interaction_claim")])
```

outs <- c(PRIMARY, SECONDARY)

save_tab(cm, "cell_means")
save_tab(rbind(factor_means(d1, 1, outs), factor_means(d2, 2, outs)), "factor_means")

# Pooled fame effects (secondary)

Fixed-effect meta-analysis of each study's artist-fame and victim-fame estimates, with Q.

```{r pooled}
show(save_tab(pooled_fame(tab1, tab2), "pooled_fame_effects"))
```

# Items asked after the outcomes

Perceived status, power, and resources by condition. These are post-outcome perceptions, not manipulation checks; no mediation analysis is run.

```{r perceptions}
perc <- rbind(factor_means(d1, 1, PERCEPTION_ITEMS), factor_means(d2, 2, PERCEPTION_ITEMS))
save_tab(perc, "perceptions_by_condition")
perc_models <- rbind(do.call(rbind, lapply(PERCEPTION_ITEMS, function(o) coef_table(fit_lm(d1, o, 1), 1, o))),
                     do.call(rbind, lapply(PERCEPTION_ITEMS, function(o) coef_table(fit_lm(d2, o, 2), 2, o))))
save_tab(perc_models, "perceptions_models_descriptive")
show(perc)
```

WorkTransform (Study 2) is a comprehension item with a reread loop. Share answering correctly for the participant's condition:

```{r worktransform}
show(save_tab(worktransform_table(d2), "worktransform_by_cell"))
```

# Checks on the main results (supplement)

Each check reruns C1-C5. A check *changes* a result if it flips the sign of the estimate or moves the Holm-adjusted p across .05. The "all finished first responses" check reads the plan literally: it ignores the comprehension checks and also keeps participants who said they were not serious. Under the ordinal and logistic checks, tests without such a model (C2 on the Harm composite; the C4 equivalence test) keep their linear result.

```{r robustness}
rob <- run_robustness(all2, conf)
save_tab(rob, "robustness_C1_C5")
show(rob)
```

Full tables under the sample variants:

```{r robustness_tables}
for (s in 1:2) {
  dall <- if (s == 1) all1 else all2
  rs <- robustness_samples(dall)
  for (nm in names(rs)) save_tab(all_terms(rs[[nm]], s), sprintf("study%d_all_terms__%s", s, nm))
}
```

# Exploratory: moderators

Whether art training or copyright familiarity changes the fame or transformation effects. Exploratory; `q_bh` is the Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment across every moderator test in the table.

```{r moderators}
mod <- rbind(moderators(d1, 1), moderators(d2, 2))
mod$q_bh <- p.adjust(mod$p, "BH")
show(save_tab(mod, "exploratory_moderators"))
```

```{r text_input}
# Input for the text pipeline (Section 7). Development set: all of Study 1 and the
# Study 2 responses in the 2025 interim file that passed the checks. Test set: the
# analyzed Study 2 responses never seen. Responses under three words are flagged.
wc <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), 0L, lengths(regmatches(x, gregexpr("[[:alnum:]']+", x))))
keep_cols <- c("pid", "study", "a", "v", "t", "artist", "victim", "transform", "cell",
               "Explain_Ruling", "AllowedReason", "Jury", "CostReason", "ReduceMarket", "Moral", "Harm", "Payment")
t1 <- d1; t1$transform <- NA; t1$text_set <- "dev"; t1$analyzed <- TRUE
t2dev <- all2[all2$passed & !is.na(all2$in_2025_interim) & all2$in_2025_interim == 1, ]
t2dev$text_set <- "dev"; t2dev$analyzed <- t2dev$included
t2test <- d2[d2$in_2025_interim == 0, ]; t2test$text_set <- "test"; t2test$analyzed <- TRUE
as_plain <- function(x) { x <- x[, c(keep_cols, "text_set", "analyzed")]
  for (f in c("artist", "victim", "transform")) x[[f]] <- as.character(x[[f]]); x }
ti <- rbind(as_plain(t1), as_plain(t2dev), as_plain(t2test))
stopifnot(all(ti$artist %in% c("famous", "unknown")), all(ti$victim %in% c("famous", "unknown")),
          all(is.na(ti$transform[ti$study == 1])), all(ti$transform[ti$study == 2] %in% c("high", "low")))
ti$n_words <- wc(ti$Explain_Ruling)
ti$text_ok <- ti$n_words >= 3
write.csv(ti, file.path(root, "Analysis", "output", params$mode, "text_input.csv"), row.names = FALSE, na = "")
```

# Session

```{r session}
writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), file.path(out_dir, "sessionInfo.txt"))
cat("Text-pipeline input written:", nrow(ti), "rows (", sum(ti$text_set == "dev"), "development,",
    sum(ti$text_set == "test"), "test;", sum(!ti$text_ok), "under three words).\n")
```
